brief.symptoms: The consumer group test fails because partition assignments for topics do not match the expected ranges. Some members receive partitions from the wrong topics.
hints: The consumer group reports mismatched partition ranges for multiple topics.
Inspect the strategy that decides which partitions each member receives.
The bug stems from how the range calculation handles leftover partitions.
brief.lesson: When a range strategy assigns partitions, it must correctly split leftovers across consumers. The fix adds per‑consumer extra‑partition handling and sorts member IDs to keep assignments deterministic.
